correctness.rationale: For any idempotent, the fixed-image criterion gives a partition into distinguished rooted stars, unlabeled rooted stars and undefined free points. Permutation stabilizers and complete orbit representatives follow exactly; labeled and unlabeled generating functions follow by independent combinatorial decompositions. The fixed-a asymptotic is derived by an explicit convolution transfer from the Hardy–Ramanujan estimate. A standalone program independently enumerates actual idempotent maps, orbit sizes and rank profiles for a=0..3 and b=0..4. No finite observation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Complete orbit-stabilizer classification across all cardinalities of the prescribed fixed set and complement, exact rank-by-orbit and rank-by-labeled-element enumerations, and a sharp partition-growth asymptotic. The probability that a random orbit type omits a distinguished point decays at a mathematically explicit square-root rate. This is a natural symmetry quotient of a studied family rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
